matching_pages_notes: Original NARA PDF pages 45 through 54 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 322 previously unaudited printed rows on pages 45, 47, 48, 49, 51, 52, and 54 were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed spelling and initials, suffixes, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Pages 46, 50, and 53 had already passed visual review; all 460 rows across the ten-page block agree with the current extraction. Literal source anomalies remain unchanged, including Alferd, WilliamR, Lelslie, Justin followed by an empty comma field and Jr., the Bradenberger 75? note beside Box 76, the Braggiotti D and C initial cells, a no first n note, America, Breycha Vauthier, Llyod, Brincherhoff, the Brion asterisk, Momuer;, Britfus, the visually truncated Bronfenbrenne Urie entry, Adelade, and two Charles J Brown rows with distinct 84 and 83 box values. Private identifiers are not included in this review bundle or public assets.
